text:
anil_bd: Quick sync — QBR prep: we need to align marketplace credits, HW partner co-funding, and SI onboarding incentives. Who can own the MDC budget recon and the scorecard targets? I can draft a proposal by EOD.

sara_partner: I can take ownership of marketplace credit split for the QBR. Need input from finance on how rigid the caps are this quarter. @luis_finance can you confirm?

luis_finance: We have a $120k MDF envelope for the quarter but ~30% is earmarked for dedicated pilots. We can flex up to 10% if we reclass allocations. Need a short justification doc.

kevin_sales: For HW partners, they want visibility into projected consumes. Can we provide a simple routing: marketplace credits -> co-fund -> HW rebate? prefer a single KPI in the scorecard: "deal enablement value"

jenna_ops: For SI onboarding incentives, timeline matters. If we patch in incentives now, we need new onboarding slots and an SLA for enablement. Ops cost is ~2 FTEs for onboarding sprint.

anil_bd: Thanks. I'll draft a one-page that maps buckets to owners and ask legal for T&Cs. Draft outline: 1) envelope & flex rules, 2) partner tiers eligible, 3) KPI/scorecard mapping, 4) ops impact, 5) SLAs

sara_partner: +1. Can you include an example allocation table? e.g., 50% marketplace, 30% co-fund, 20% SI onboarding for Tier 1.

anil_bd: putting a quick table in chat:
```csv
bucket, tier1, tier2, tier3
marketplace, 50%, 40%, 30%
co-fund (HW), 30%, 35%, 40%
si-onboard, 20%, 25%, 30%
```

luis_finance: That table needs a column for "reserved pilots" and "contingency". Add 10% contingency line not exceeding envelope.

kevin_sales: Also add "lead credits" usage example: if partner deploys to marketplace and converts, marketplace credits reduce Redwood invoice by X. Need language for sales enablement.

jenna_ops: Ops question — any changes to enablement pricing? we should attach a sample SOW snippet.

anil_bd: I'll attach sample SOW and a justification paragraph. Can @sara_partner review marketplace copy and @kevin_sales review enablement wording? If we agree, I'll submit to luis for budget sign-off.

sara_partner: Happy to review. Can we get this into the QBR deck by Thursday?

kevin_sales: Thursday works. I'll add two slides: 1) forecast & conversion assumptions, 2) GTM triggers for co-funding.

luis_finance: I'll mark budget hold until I get the justification. If we need to reclass, route through #budget_recon channel.

deploy-bot: deploy notice: QBR deck template updated (version 3.2) — https://redwood.app/qbr/template :calendar:

anil_bd: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the draft doc here when ready. :thumbsup:
